# Report Builder

`report` &middot; _reporting_

Turns your findings and audit trail into an HTML, JSON or CSV report.

**Low impact.** Reading public information or local files.

## What this tool needs

- Nothing extra. Uses the app's own findings database.

## How to use it

Record findings as you work, then export a report (HTML for reading, JSON or CSV for processing). All output is escaped so tool output cannot inject into the report.

- Category: `reporting`
- Install with: built into the app
